name: Growth Terminal Instagram Conversion System
objective: Turn feed attention into qualified interest in Growth Terminal custom digital experiences.

rules: Signal orange is the only accent.
No gradients used as the main visual.
No large empty grey fields.
The artwork must still work if every decorative effect is removed.
One dominant headline. Nothing competes with it.
No tiny navigation-style typography.
No paragraph blocks on the artwork.
Fraunces is not used in the conversion system.
The hook must be readable on a phone before the caption is opened.

cta.style: high-contrast action line or signal-orange action block

hero.rule: One hero visual demonstrates the service. It must not be a website header crop, a generic browser rectangle, or decorative filler.

rules: Asymmetry over centered poster layouts.
Hero visual owns most of the frame.
Use one primary idea per post.
Do not place a full website navigation bar inside an Instagram creative.
Do not use empty texture or blank color as the hero.
If the visual does not demonstrate the offer, the post fails.
Every post names or unmistakably shows what Growth Terminal sells.
Every post gives the viewer a next action on the artwork, not only in the caption.
Generic education is not a conversion objective.
No post may use content_type=informative.
No philosophical statement is allowed unless the second read ties directly to a service.

experience-demo.purpose: Show what an interactive or immersive experience feels like.
experience-demo.cover_formula: service demonstration + 3 to 7 word hook + visible next action

buyer-problem.purpose: Name the buyer's current website or launch problem and make the contrast visual.
buyer-problem.cover_formula: recognizable problem + visual contrast + next action

launch-transformation.purpose: Show how a static product story becomes a launch sequence.
launch-transformation.cover_formula: before/after or assembled/revealed sequence + direct promise

process-proof.purpose: Make the custom process tangible without inventing client results.
process-proof.cover_formula: real deliverable or workflow + concise outcome + next action

reject_patterns: stock dashboard screenshot with no story
decorative 3D object with no relation to the service
